integrity: Complete proof and executable finite checks supplied; exhaustive checks of bounded instances do not replace the universal structural-recursion proof. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite prefixes of iterated classicality in minimal LET_F^- bivaluation semantics, and their positive signed/unsigned fragments; not LET_F^+ nor arbitrary one-letter formulas. Prior no-finite-matrix obstruction and Dedekind numbers are known. Priority among specialized treatments remains to be independently assessed.
title: Exact classicality profiles and signed positive fragments in minimal evidence logic
